name: The majority voted in favour of *disagreeing* with a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2021-08-10.6.2) introduced by Paterson MP [Meryl Swanson](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/paterson/meryl_swanson) (Labor), which means the motion failed. ### Motion text > *That all words after "That" be omitted with a view to substituting the following words:* > > *"whilst not declining to give the bill a [second reading](https://peo.gov.au/understand-our-parliament/how-parliament-works/bills-and-laws/making-a-law-in-the-australian-parliament/), the House notes that:* > > *(1) international trade will be crucial to Australia's post COVID-19 economic recovery; and* > > *(2) the Government's inability to secure a variety of vaccines has left Australians dangerously vulnerable—particularly those in trade exposed industries".*
